title: Red Bull confirms Lagrue as Red Bull Junior Program director from 2027
summary: Red Bull has poached Mercedes' long-time driver development chief Gwen Lagrue to lead its own junior program following the departure of Helmut Marko.

title: Verstappen doesn't understand how he finished second in Hungarian GP after car struggles
summary: Max Verstappen called his scond place at the Hungarian Grand Prix an "overperformance", the result coming in spite of continued car difficulties.

title: Wolff slams ‘Teletubbies’ engineers over Antonelli traffic
summary: Toto Wolff was less than impressed with traffic interfering with the racing between Kimi Antonelli and Lewis Hamilton in the Hungarian Grand Prix.

title: Will McLaren’s Budapest breakthrough turn the tide?
summary: The reigning F1 world champions’ first win of the season was all the more encouraging for how decisive its race pace advantage looked.

title: Hamilton questions late pit stop as podium slips away
summary: Lewis Hamilton feels he missed out on a podium finish in the Hungarian Grand Prix as a result of Ferrari’s late call to make a pit stop under virtual safety car that cost him track position.

title: Sainz defends Piastri contact amid blue flag issues
summary: Carlos Sainz downplayed his contact with Oscar Piastri in the Hungarian Grand Prix, suggesting the McLaren driver could have taken more care due to a blue flag system failure.

title: Piastri fumes at Sainz but tapers down McLaren criticism
summary: Oscar Piastri says Carlos Sainz should “look in the mirror a bit” after branding their collision during the Hungarian Grand Prix as “unacceptable.”

title: Norris puts McLaren back on top with dominating Hungarian GP win
summary: Lando Norris won the Hungarian Grand Prix in decisive fashion after McLaren teammate Oscar Piastri was hit by lapped traffic while attempting to defend his lead and then retired with gearbox trouble.

title: Malaysia back on F1 calendar as Bahrain stand-in
summary: The Sepang International Circuit will return to Formula 1 later this year as host for the postponed Bahrain Grand Prix, which will be known as "the 2026 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia."
